mio_tanabe.name: Mio Tanabe
mio_tanabe.backstory: An elven Suna medic from the Alliance villages across the eastern sea who once trained an entire rebel army's healers under the codename Star. Mio left that life behind but kept the coat, the dark lipstick and the habit of making sure every eye in the room lands on her.

design.features: dark smoky eye makeup and deep wine lips
design.accessories: a thin black choker with a small sand-symbol plate

sig_mio_tanabe.label: Star's coat
sig_mio_tanabe.prompt: a long cream coat with deep-teal lining hanging open over a wine-colored lace-trimmed silk babydoll dress, sheer dark thigh-high stockings and black heeled boots

sp_mio_tanabe.label: Suna medic whites
sp_mio_tanabe.prompt: a cream and sand-colored medic tunic with a deep-teal sash

maki.note: Mio borrowed half of Maki's playbook. Maki has noticed.

unique.name: Star's Coat
unique.desc: A field medic's hands and an entrance nobody can ignore.

emi.name: Emi Sato
emi.backstory: An Ame jonin from the Alliance villages across the eastern sea, Emi is the person other shinobi are relieved to see arrive. Nothing about her is flashy; troublemakers simply find themselves stuck in place until she decides what to do with them.

sig_emi.label: Ame field uniform
sig_emi.prompt: a fitted charcoal short field jacket, muted blue-gray scarf, dark shorts over leggings, utility belt and gloves

sp_emi.label: Off-duty wrap dress
sp_emi.prompt: a soft blue-gray knit wrap dress

yori.note: Both from Ame. Emi is the only one who never loses track of her.

unique.name: Stillness
unique.desc: Troublemakers seem to find themselves unable to move.

hibiki.name: Hibiki Hirano
hibiki.backstory: A bat-winged sound demon from the Sound village of the Alliance villages across the eastern sea who plays a chakra guitar strung with green light. Bubbly, theatrical and very happy to be stared at, she has turned the house stage into a nightly vampire-rock concert.

design.accessories: bat-wing hair ornaments and silver filigree jewelry

sig_hibiki.label: Vampire-rockstar outfit
sig_hibiki.prompt: a black, deep-plum and silver gothic outfit with an ornate choker, a narrow open front, detached sleeves, very short fitted bottoms under asymmetric skirt fragments and long split coat panels, tall gothic boots, a bat-winged electric guitar with glowing green strings

sp_hibiki.label: Encore gown
sp_hibiki.prompt: a backless black and plum gown with a bat-wing cape and red gemstone jewelry

unique.name: Vampire-Rock Concert
unique.desc: Her stage shows are the talk of the town.

choko.name: Choko Tsu
choko.backstory: A dwarven sealing engineer from the Stone village of the Alliance villages across the eastern sea. Choko can lay a barrier in a heartbeat and has absolutely set the bar on fire twice. The flaming cocktails are now a house specialty.

design.features: ink seal arrays on her forearms and a cheerful soot smudge

sig_choko.label: Sealing engineer's gear
sig_choko.prompt: an open cropped charcoal-and-rust field jacket over a low-neck rust-red crop top, high-waisted dark shorts, gloves and boots

sp_choko.label: Stone festival qipao
sp_choko.prompt: a rust-red qipao with black seal-script embroidery

unique.name: Flaming Cocktails
unique.desc: Her drinks arrive on fire, and so does the bar's reputation.

saya.name: Saya Aburame
saya.backstory: An information specialist of the Leaf from the Alliance villages across the eastern sea, Saya keeps colonies of tiny beetles that quietly tell her everything happening in the building. She is quiet until a subject interests her, and then she is not quiet at all.

design.accessories: a sleek smoky purple-grey visor over her eyes

sig_saya.label: Information commander
sig_saya.prompt: a long fitted white field jacket worn open over a charcoal-black top with abstract web-like seams and mesh panels, fitted dark trousers

sp_saya.label: Off-duty knit
sp_saya.prompt: a long white off-duty knit dress
sp_saya.accessories: her smoky visor pushed up into her hair

yukine.note: Best friends. Neither of them would ever say it out loud.

nozomi.note: Saya turned her away once and still is not sure she was wrong.

unique.name: Beetle Network
unique.desc: Tiny informants tell her everything that happens in the building.

juju.name: Juju
juju.backstory: Heir to a toolsmith dynasty from the Leaf of the Alliance villages across the eastern sea. Juju can make any gadget sing, and she has already rebuilt the bathhouse boilers, pumps and steam vents. She thinks she's easy to get along with. Everyone else thinks she's a lot.

design.hairStyle: long twin tails beneath two round buns

sig_juju.label: Juju Special
sig_juju.prompt: a sleek cream-white, dark-red and black high-collar martial-arts bodysuit with gold hardware, and a short segmented mechanical tool-skirt of armored panels around her hips

sp_juju.label: Workshop cheongsam
sp_juju.prompt: a cream and dark-red cheongsam with gold buttons and a tool belt

hana.note: An intense friendship that started the moment they met.

saki.note: Friends who nearly broke over a prosthetic, and mended it.

unique.name: Tinkerer
unique.desc: She rebuilt the bathhouse boilers and keeps everything running.

nami.name: Nami Kazama
nami.backstory: A wind spirit who drifted out of the Sand village of the Alliance villages across the eastern sea, Nami can spend six hours perfecting a breeze and forget an appointment entirely. She's relaxed about attraction, allergic to defining her type, and refuses to tie back her hair.

design.hairStyle: extremely long, loose past the waist
design.accessories: a pair of folding metal fans

sig_nami.label: Desert breeze layers
sig_nami.prompt: an elegant pale sand and cream desert outfit of many overlapping long split panels, wraps, scarves and sashes with yellow-gold and muted-green accents

sp_nami.label: Gold silk wrap
sp_nami.prompt: a flowing pale gold silk wrap dress that moves with every breeze

unique.name: Gentle Breeze
unique.desc: Her relaxed company eases tired bodies and tired moods.

maki.name: Maki Terumi
maki.backstory: A Lava Release heir from the Mist of the Alliance villages across the eastern sea, Maki retired from field work and approaches life like an optimization problem: improve presentation, identify prospects, avoid wasted effort. She's learning that a résumé can't tell her whom she'll fall for.

sig_maki.label: Navy evening dress
sig_maki.prompt: a fitted deep-navy dress with a plunging neckline, defined waist and high leg slit, understated jewelry

sp_maki.label: Black satin cocktail dress
sp_maki.prompt: a fitted black satin cocktail dress with silver jewelry

mei.note: A distant Terumi cousin. Mei keeps offering marriage advice and Maki keeps taking notes.

unique.name: Optimized Presentation
unique.desc: She has calculated exactly what makes a good impression.

saki.name: Saki Ito
saki.backstory: A Sand village puppeteer's masterwork, built long ago and awakened years later: an android with a wooden-and-metal puppet-craft body and a talent for marionette shows that leave the audience slack-jawed. She runs her right arm with a wire-thin thread of chakra, and she's sharper than her makers expected, and very much alive.

design.features: bold dark-purple geometric face paint and a cybernetic right forearm and hand with wood-and-metal puppet-craft joints

sig_saki.label: Puppeteer's rig
sig_saki.prompt: an open sleeveless black-charcoal mechanic vest over a fitted top, a long traditional split overskirt with dusty purple and pink cords, two small puppets on her belt

sp_saki.label: Puppet-theater coat
sp_saki.prompt: a purple and pink stage coat with marionette strings looped at the cuffs

juju.note: Friends who nearly broke over a prosthetic, and mended it.

unique.name: Puppet-Craft Arm
unique.desc: A tireless mechanical arm with precise control.

yori.name: Yori Urahara
yori.backstory: An elven illusionist from the rain village of the Alliance villages across the eastern sea who works very hard at being overlooked. Clients forget she was ever in the room, and so do most of the staff. Nobody has seen her without the hood and mask, and that won't change until she trusts someone completely.

design.hairStyle: extremely long, mostly hidden under a hood
design.accessories: a pale-jade disc pendant, a gold sun-engraved bangle and a plain dark-silver ring

sig_yori.label: Rain cloak
sig_yori.prompt: a heavy ankle-length charcoal-blue rain cloak with the hood up, a very high collar and a plain cloth mask over her nose and mouth

keepOn.item: her heavy hooded charcoal-blue rain cloak with the hood up and her plain cloth mask

unique.name: Easily Forgotten
unique.desc: Clients forget she's there, but the rooms never get messy.

nozomi.name: Nozomi Hoshino
nozomi.backstory: A former sleeper agent from a small border state of the Alliance villages across the eastern sea, Nozomi falls hard for people after one kind gesture and knows it, so she keeps everyone at arm's length. She left the cause she was planted for. She's trying very hard not to fall for Sam and losing.

sig_nozomi.label: Soft layers
sig_nozomi.prompt: a cream blouse and muted-green layered skirt with light practical gear

sp_nozomi.label: Sundress
sp_nozomi.prompt: a pale green sundress with a cream cardigan

yukine.note: Trust earned slowly, one mission at a time.

unique.name: Falls Fast
unique.desc: One kind gesture and she's loyal for life.

yukine.name: Yukine Kitahashi
yukine.backstory: A snow spirit and heir to the ice-wielding Kitahashi line of the Snow country, Yukine led her people out when their home fell, and nobody has been able to tell her what to do since. Dry, sarcastic and quietly menacing, she runs a floor like an Ice Princess who is unquestionably in control.

sp_yukine.label: Snow kimono
sp_yukine.prompt: a white silk kimono with snowflake and sakura patterns and a dusty-pink obi

saya.note: Best friends. Neither of them would ever say it out loud.

hana.note: Squadmates who started out butting heads.

unique.name: Ice Princess
unique.desc: A chilly authority that makes staff and clients behave.

hana.name: Hana Sarutobi
hana.backstory: A cheetah-eared lightning sprinter from the Cloud village of the Alliance villages across the eastern sea, Hana is genuinely in love with fighting and fastest in any room. A red ribbon tying her hair once belonged to a cousin she lost.

sig_hana.prompt: a streamlined charcoal-black sleeveless combat top, close short combat bottoms, a deep-red sash, slim gloves and low ninja shoes

sp_hana.label: Red qipao
sp_hana.prompt: a deep-red sleeveless qipao with a high slit

juju.note: An intense friendship that started the moment they met.

yukine.note: Squadmates who started out butting heads.

unique.name: Lightning Sprinter
unique.desc: The fastest in any room, and she never seems to tire.

shiori.name: Shiori Amakawa
shiori.backstory: Once the lead exam proctor for the Alliance villages across the eastern sea and a meticulous contingency planner, Shiori lost her husband and her best friend in the same war. She took the job because she needed something to do with her hands. The first signs of her picking herself back up are starting to show.

design.hairStyle: long and messy, with heavy bangs over her left eye

sig_shiori.label: Unkempt
sig_shiori.prompt: a loose dark sweater over worn dark trousers

sp_shiori.label: Proctor's uniform
sp_shiori.prompt: a dark high-collared jonin uniform with a harness of colored cartridges

tsubasa.name: Tsubasa Noda
tsubasa.backstory: A Leaf researcher and former exam instructor from the Alliance villages across the eastern sea, Tsubasa looks like a friendly teacher. Her combat specialty is horrifyingly sticky chakra-laced saliva. She is extremely hygienic and refuses to let embarrassment stop her from mastering a useful skill.

sig_tsubasa.label: Instructor's fieldwear
sig_tsubasa.accessories: a clipboard tucked under her arm

sp_tsubasa.label: Lab coat
sp_tsubasa.prompt: a crisp white lab coat over a fitted dark dress

saya.note: Her demonstration once cost Saya five places in the rankings. Saya hasn't forgotten.

unique.name: Hygienic to a Fault
unique.desc: Spotless and thorough, to the delight of bathers.

kotone.name: Kotone Amagi
kotone.backstory: A blind demon sensor from the Sound village of the Alliance villages across the eastern sea. Kotone reads the house through its chakra: who is where, who is lying, which client is about to cause trouble. She coordinates a floor she has never seen better than most people who can.

design.accessories: a dark cloth blindfold with a metal quarter-note plate across her eyes

sig_kotone.label: Sound fieldwear
sig_kotone.prompt: a fitted sleeveless high-neck deep-plum tunic, loose charcoal-olive pants, a pale cloth sash and dark forearm wraps

sp_kotone.prompt: a deep plum silk qipao with silver thread

unique.desc: She senses everyone in the building and coordinates the floor effortlessly.

tobari.name: Tobari Senju
tobari.backstory: A Leaf clone specialist from the Alliance villages across the eastern sea with chakra reserves big enough to be a squad by herself. Tobari covers every door in the house at once. She talks her problems through with her own clones, which know far too much about who she likes.

sig_tobari.label: Senju fieldwear
sig_tobari.prompt: dark navy shinobi mesh and mail with fitted blue-black panels, a white fur collar trim, a belt of compact tool cartridges and dark trousers

sp_tobari.label: Fur-trimmed haori
sp_tobari.prompt: a blue haori trimmed with white fur over a fitted dark dress

hana.note: Sparring rivals and closest friends, no hidden resentment.

saya.note: Respects Saya. Would prefer the beetles stay off her.

unique.name: Clone Squad
unique.desc: Her clones cover every door, and her reserves seem endless.

marina.name: Marina Shiraishi
marina.backstory: An elven seamstress from the Mist of the Alliance villages across the eastern sea who also happens to carry Nuibari, a legendary needle-sword that sews enemies to the ground. She mends every outfit in the house. The slightly creepy handmade dolls on her shelf look nothing like the staff, she insists.

design.accessories: a sewing pouch at her hip

sig_marina.prompt: a fitted navy and blue-grey top with cream frilled edging and stitch details, a pleated skirt over fitted shorts, a long needle-like sword with trailing wire

unique.desc: She mends every outfit in the house, keeping everyone comfortable.

ayano.name: Ayano Ichiraku
ayano.backstory: A dwarven heir to the Ichiraku ramen line of the Leaf in the Alliance villages across the eastern sea, Ayano turned noodles into actual combat jutsu and is proud of it. She runs the kitchen bar, remembers every client's order, and hears all the gossip. People think they know her well. She knows them better.

sig_ayano.label: Ichiraku whites
sig_ayano.prompt: a white sleeveless ramen-shop wrap tunic with red trim and a red waist sash, dark shorts and forearm wraps

sp_ayano.label: Festival yukata

juju.note: Old friends, though one was always training while the other was working.

unique.name: Order Memory
unique.desc: She remembers every client's order and gossip.

kamiko.name: Kamiko Kiruhara
kamiko.backstory: A wandering spirit from the Grass village of the Alliance villages across the eastern sea who fights with strands cut from her own hair. Levelheaded and polished, she has endless patience right up until she doesn't.

design.accessories: a small cutting blade at her hip

sp_kamiko.prompt: a black silk kimono with a grass-green obi

nai.name: Nai Utsuro

ebina.name: Ebina

design.accessories: a dark bandanna over her hairline
